'''Hover Pods''' were devices<ref name="Cartel Market" /> used around the time of the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|7.0}}</ref> to transport small objects, creatures, or individuals. Utilizing [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] technology for locomotion, these pods could be programmed to automatically follow their owner.<ref name="Cartel Market" />

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]]<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> mini-pet debuted within the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]], announced on [[February 15]], [[2022]], as part of a tie-in promotion for the [[Disney+]] television series [[Star Wars: The Mandalorian|''The Mandalorian'']],<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20220215-1|text=Cartel Market Additions: Game Update 7.0}}</ref> being directly inspired by [[Din Grogu|Grogu's]] [[Hover pram|hovering pram]] featured heavily in the show.<ref name="The Mandalorian">''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''</ref>
